GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH AllSalesData AS (
    SELECT
        'Myntra' AS sales_channel,
        TRY_CAST(oms.total_amount AS DOUBLE) AS order_value,
        oms.order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.myntra_oms oms
    WHERE
        oms.group_level_id = '22'
        AND oms.is_active = true
        AND oms.order_status = 'COMPLETED'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'LimeRoad' AS sales_channel,
        settlement.gmv_amount AS order_value,
        settlement.order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.limeroad_settlement settlement
    WHERE
        settlement.group_level_id = '22'
        AND settlement.is_active = true
        AND settlement.order_status = 'COMPLETED'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        sales.sales_channel,
        sales.total_amount AS order_value,
        sales.order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.increff_sales sales
    WHERE
        sales.group_level_id = '22'
        AND sales.is_active = true
        AND sales.order_status = 'COMPLETED'
        AND sales.transaction_type = 'SALES'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Amazon' AS sales_channel,
        TRY_CAST(amazon_oms.total_amount AS DOUBLE) AS order_value,
        amazon_oms.order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.amazon_oms amazon_oms
    WHERE
        amazon_oms.group_level_id = '22'
        AND amazon_oms.is_active = true
        AND amazon_oms.order_status = 'COMPLETED'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Meesho' AS sales_channel,
        meesho_sales.charged_amount AS order_value,
        meesho_sales.order_id
    FROM
        zs_observe.meesho_sales meesho_sales
    WHERE
        meesho_sales.group_level_id = '22'
        AND meesho_sales.is_active = true
        AND meesho_sales.order_status = 'Delivered'
)
SELECT
    sales_channel,
    SUM(order_value) AS total_sales_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(order_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS average_order_value
FROM
    AllSalesData
GROUP BY
    sales_channel
ORDER BY
    sales_channel;
